subject: E-3307: quota exceeded on Linux
body:
Hi, I'm using MeshMail 2.8.8 on Fedora 41. Whenever I upload a file since last
week, the app shows 'E-3307: storage quota exceeded'.

The plan was upgraded yesterday; the app still displays the old quota. The
website shows the new allowance correctly.

Before writing in I tried closing every other program; same error afterwards.

Regards, Fatima Zahra, Brightwater Clinics
